headline: Names a Post Office building in Akron, Ohio, after the late Judge James R. Williams.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 675 Wolf Ledges Parkway in Akron, Ohio, as the Judge James R. Williams Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only and does not change mail service, staffing, or postal rules. The official summary does not describe any other effects.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025, and the designation applies from that date.
